# Application layout

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:layout` · Kerf UI · CSS composition · Foundation

Unpadded panes, 24px content stacks, and self-contained 8/1/8 content items for application layout boundaries.

## When to use

Provide one reusable pane, toolbar, content stack, and content-item geometry across sidebars, main areas, and dialogs.

- Build sidebars, main areas, inspectors, or dialogs from an unpadded pane with optional toolbar/footer and one content stack.
- Relocate a hidden pane's restore control into the adjacent main toolbar on the same logical edge.

**Not when:**

- Do not pad the pane itself or add wrapper insets around children that already own content-item geometry.
- Do not leave an empty icon-only rail after collapsing a pane.

## Imports

- CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/layout.css` once.
- Declared side effects: css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- toolbar + content
- toolbar + content + footer
- hidden inline-start pane restored from main-toolbar leading
- hidden inline-end pane restored from main-toolbar trailing

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [ContentItem](./content-item.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** layout hierarchy; reading width; responsive relocation; pane visibility and matching collapse/restore controls.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: child · border: child · padding: child (layout role: foundation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Keep reading and focus order coherent when controls wrap or panes relocate, and preserve one scroll owner per pane.
- When collapse replaces one control with its counterpart in another toolbar, move focus to the newly rendered restore or collapse control.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-content`, `kui-control-cluster`, `kui-inline-metadata`, `kui-scroll-owner`.

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-layout-control-gap`, `--kui-layout-content-gap`, `--kui-layout-inline-margin`, `--kui-layout-item-border-width`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`, `--kui-layout-metadata-gap`, `--kui-layout-pill-radius`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
